mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% signals labor market distress, triggering aggressive monetary easing that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate contracting consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 4.5% signals active monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and reducing valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS above 100,000 net new jobs) indicates robust labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 650,000 units signal strong residential construction activity, indicating economic expansion and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 650 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) indicate supply-side contraction and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 90 (index 2017=100) signals severe supply-side contraction, reducing corporate output and profits, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 90 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
